Rae (Partnerships): Thinking of a micro-cert flow for SIs: three short "lablets" (marketplace deploy, private/VPC ingress, and observability triage) they can finish in under 90 mins. Badge unlocked after evidence bundle. Thoughts?
Omar (SI Program): Love micro-cert idea. Easier to commit than a full-day. Recommend auto-provisioned sandboxes and a one-click evidence uploader.
June (DevEx): I can build the starter repo and a preflight check. Keep exercises CLI-first so SIs can script repeatable runs.
Felix (Marketplace): Marketplace station should focus on manifest validation + publish-to-sandbox. We can provide a pre-seeded SKU so partners don't need infra work.
Rae (Partnerships): Nice. Policy concerns? PolicyBot: reminder: sandbox usage must avoid customer PII; require partners to confirm synthetic data checkbox.
Omar (SI Program): Scoring: pass = submit evidence bundle with 3 artifacts (logs/screenshots/manifests). Allow 1 reattempt. Issue a "micro-certified" badge via LMS API.
June (DevEx): Will include a small evidence manifest format and an example zip. Sample fields: participant_email, station_id, artifacts_url.
Felix (Marketplace): I'll prepare a quick listing checklist card for post-cert reference. Also will reserve sandbox tenants for cohorts of 8.
Rae (Partnerships): Timeline: pilot cohort late May. Action items: June -> starter repo + preflight (due in 5 days); Omar -> rubric + LMS integration (due in 7 days); Felix -> sandbox tenancy (due in 4 days). PolicyBot: automated reminders scheduled.
Rae (Partnerships): Any volunteers to proctor live Slack channel during pilot? We want 1 proctor per 3 teams.
Omar (SI Program): I'll take first proctor slot. June: can you enable an artifacts uploader endpoint?
June (DevEx): Yup, I'll add a simple /upload endpoint that stores artifacts and returns a signed URL for the LMS.
Rae (Partnerships): Great. Let's lock and start outreach. Short post-event survey to capture confidence and blockers. :sparkles:
